question: Which of the following text was written by Banabhatta?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kadambari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kadambari** is a renowned Sanskrit prose romance written by **Banabhatta**, a celebrated writer in the court of **King Harsha**.
 
• Banabhatta was an eminent 7th-century Sanskrit scholar and poet during the reign of **Harsha (606–647 CE)**, a ruler of the Vardhana dynasty.
 
• The **Kadambari** is considered one of the most significant works of prose in classical Sanskrit literature. It is appreciated for its intricate storyline, rich vocabulary, and poetic descriptions.
 
• The narrative revolves around themes of **love, reincarnation, and destiny**, intricately weaving multiple subplots and characters into the main story.
